# IRONSIGHT

> Free open-source OSINT dashboard for Iran/Israel and Russia/Ukraine: live news, Telegram, aircraft, naval tracking, missile alerts and markets. No API keys.

## Pages

- [Home](https://noblerworks-hq.github.io/IRONSIGHT/): overview, FAQ
- [IRONSIGHT data sources](https://noblerworks-hq.github.io/IRONSIGHT/data-sources/): Every free OSINT source IRONSIGHT uses: alert APIs, ADS-B aircraft, NASA FIRMS, Polymarket, news RSS and Telegram, with the polling interval of each feed.
- [Iran / Israel theater](https://noblerworks-hq.github.io/IRONSIGHT/iran-israel/): The IRONSIGHT Iran/Israel theater: live Pikud HaOref siren alerts, military aircraft, Gulf and Red Sea naval tracking, translated Telegram OSINT and markets.
- [Russia / Ukraine theater](https://noblerworks-hq.github.io/IRONSIGHT/russia-ukraine/): The IRONSIGHT Russia/Ukraine theater: live Shahed drone, cruise missile and glide-bomb tracks, oblast air-raid alerts, Black Sea naval tracking and Telegram.
- [Run IRONSIGHT yourself](https://noblerworks-hq.github.io/IRONSIGHT/self-hosting/): Self-host the IRONSIGHT OSINT dashboard in one command with Docker, or run it with Node.js 22. No API keys or environment variables needed.
